propositions: A mapped project key that is nonexistent or inaccessible to the bridge bot must be caught by a preflight validation step before any Jira mutation occurs
The preflight must validate both explicitly mapped projects and the legacy_default fallback project, as well as the query_project fallback when projects mapping is empty
Transport failures (auth/HTTP errors) during project visibility probing must fail closed and raise TransportUnavailableError rather than treating partial results as authoritative
The preflight must only probe when the configured backend is 'jira' (Cloud) and must skip gracefully for other backends or clients lacking _direct_rest_get

Preflight validation must enumerate bot-visible projects via paginated GET /rest/api/3/project/search with hard page-cap guards and must abort the reconcile pass with a classified OPERATIONAL_FAILURE before reconcile_once is called
The check_mapped_project_visibility helper must be reusable and importable for both the reconciler preflight and the bridge fsck diagnostic (ticket 9702)
